# Verdict CLI — Cumulative Web Inc

Verdict CLI is deterministic, evidence-bound trust scoring for AI agents: the
CWI Verdict Engine v1.0.0 as runnable software.

- Feed it evidence JSON (ERC-8004 identity signals, Needle Drop verified
  history, First Spin published verdicts); get back a verdict — a score
  (0–1) with a published band and a full evidence trace — or an honest
  refusal: insufficient-data, evidence-disputed, unknown-context, or
  invalid-input.
- It NEVER invents a score. Garbage evidence in, garbage score out; this tool
  scores evidence, it does not create trust.
- Admission: only status "verified" evidence counts. claimed/pending/refuted
  count zero. Any "disputed" item refuses the whole run.
- Deterministic: no clock, no randomness, no network. Same input →
  byte-identical output, bound by input_sha256.
- The engine (verdict_cli/_engine.py) is the canonical CWI Verdict Engine
  copied VERBATIM (pinned blob, never edited; weights, thresholds, and gates
  are spec-versioned). The test suite asserts the vendored file's sha256.

## Run it

Requires Python 3.8+, stdlib only — no pip install, no network, no accounts.

    git clone https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-verdict-cli.git
    cd cwi-verdict-cli
    python3 -m verdict_cli example > evidence.json
    python3 -m verdict_cli score evidence.json --out ./run-001

Commands: score, check (one-line pipeline verdict), example, spec (published
scoring rules), pin (vendored engine provenance for audit).

Cross-check: cwi-mcp-server's trust_verdict tool runs the byte-identical
vendored engine v1.0.0 this CLI wraps.
